Codex reports token usage but no cost.
External Codex sessions cannot be listed or stopped from Agent Office.
Managed sessions use `agent acp` (Agent Client Protocol, JSON-RPC over stdio).
Values marked runtime are negotiated from the ACP initialize response per session.
Cursor CLI hooks are reported to fire only partially; external sessions are experimental.
ACP has no standard subagent concept; subagents are not shown for Cursor.
Cursor CLI could not be executed during research; Phase 5 verifies on Windows 11.
